title: Alien in Autumn Rain
description: A green alien with large black eyes and sharp teeth stands on a wet country road during a rainstorm at sunset. Behind and around its head is a large swirling mass of purple tentacle-like hair adorned with golden crescent moons and glowing orange eyes.
prompt: A muscular green alien with a large head, glossy black eyes and sharp teeth stands on a rural road during autumn rain at sunset. It has an enormous swirling mass of purple tentacle hair decorated with golden crescent moons and glowing orange eyes emerging from the strands. Trees with orange and yellow leaves line the winding road, leaves falling in the rain, dramatic colorful sky, detailed fantasy painting style
